summary: Enhance your fundraising skills with our Building Donor Trust and Transparency Training. Learn to foster relationships and boost donor confidence effectively.
lede: Donor trust and transparency training helps teams make the use of funds, decisions, and results clear to donors. It is for project and program managers, grant and partnership staff, monitoring and evaluation teams, finance and compliance professionals, and leaders responsible for donor-funded work. Participants learn to document spending and approvals, report evidence and mixed results honestly, and communicate risks or issues while managing donor expectations.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals who regularly interact with donors or manage donor-funded work, ensuring they have the skills to build, maintain, and protect donor trust through transparent practice.
modules: Transparent Financial Stewardship for Donor Funds
Evidence, MEL, and Proof of Impact
Risk Management, Safeguarding, and Issue Handling
Ethics, Conflicts of Interest, and Anti-Corruption Culture
Action Planning for Donor Trust and Transparency
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of donor-funded project management and financial reporting. Experience in NGO or public sector work is recommended.
